hero.headline: Your Codebase, Fully Tested. Automatically.
hero.subheadline: Orbit reads your repo, understands your app, generates test plans, and executes them — all autonomously. No test engineers. No hand-written scripts. Just coverage that evolves with your code.

howItWorks.headline: From zero to full coverage in four steps

steps.title: Connect Your Repo
steps.description: One-click GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket OAuth. Orbit gets read access to your code structure — never stores your source.

steps.title: AI Indexes Everything
steps.description: Tree-sitter AST parsing maps every route, component, endpoint, and auth flow into a living System Map in under 90 seconds.

steps.title: Generate Test Plans
steps.description: The planning agent creates prioritized test cases covering user journeys, API contracts, edge cases, and security flows.

steps.title: Execute & Report
steps.description: Real browsers run your tests via Playwright + Stagehand. Get pass/fail results, screenshots, videos, and AI failure analysis.

features.headline: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
features.subheadline: Built for teams that ship fast and need test coverage that keeps up.

items.title: System Map
items.description: A living, interactive graph of your entire application — routes, components, APIs, auth flows. Orbit sees what you built.

items.title: Self-Healing Tests
items.description: When selectors break, Stagehand + LLM find the right element automatically. No more flaky selector maintenance.

items.title: Code-Aware Planning
items.description: Tests generated from AST analysis, not URL crawling. Orbit understands your auth guards, validation schemas, and business logic.

items.title: Live Execution
items.description: Watch tests run in real time. See the browser navigate, fill forms, click buttons — with video replay and screenshots.

items.title: AI Failure Analysis
items.description: When a test fails, Orbit explains why in plain English, suggests a fix, and can open a Linear issue or GitHub issue automatically.

items.title: PR-Triggered Runs
items.description: Every pull request gets diff-aware regression tests. Only test what changed. Results in under 3 minutes, blocking merge on failure.

items.title: Continuous Updates
items.description: Push code, Orbit re-indexes and updates test plans automatically. Your test suite is always in sync with your app.

items.title: Integrations
items.description: Linear, Slack, GitHub Checks, VS Code extension, CLI, webhooks. Orbit fits into your existing workflow.

comparison.headline: How Orbit compares
comparison.subheadline: The only platform that combines all four: code-aware, app-aware, fully autonomous, and continuously updated.

cta.headline: Ready to test smarter?
cta.subheadline: Connect your repo and get your first test run in under 5 minutes. Free tier included.
